projectFile.description: The project's anchor: the repository-relative path of the `.kicad_pro`, equal to the manifest's `config.project_file`.

projectName.description: KiCad's `${PROJECTNAME}`: the `.kicad_pro` file name without its last suffix.

textVariables.description: The `.kicad_pro` `text_variables`, keyed by variable name, keys in code point order; values as written. Empty when the file has none.

netClasses.description: The `.kicad_pro` net classes, in file order (`net_settings.classes[]`). Empty when the file has none.

documents.description: The root schematic, every schematic file reached from it (each once, however many sheets instantiate it), and the board, sorted by `path` in code point order. Empty when the project has neither a schematic nor a board.

references.description:
Every path reference of the scanned files, sorted by `documentPath`,
then `kind`, then `raw`, then `sheetUuid`, then `field`, then
`libraryName`, then the embedded target's `footprintUuid`, each in code
point order, an absent value before any present one. No two entries are
equal. The scanned files are the `.kicad_pro`, `documents`, the
project's `fp-lib-table` and `sym-lib-table`, and every drawing-sheet
file a `drawing-sheet` reference resolves to inside the sources.

description:
`projections/project.json`: the project file's facts, the header of every
schematic file of the hierarchy and of the board, and every path
reference they make. Empty form: a project without a schematic or a board
lists only what the files it has state.
title: Project a0

RepoPath.description:
Repository-relative POSIX path, exactly as `git ls-tree` names the entry:
`/`-separated, case preserved, no leading `/`, no empty, `.` or `..`
segment, no backslash and no `:`. The same character rule as ArchivePath.
It is the only path type in bundle documents: a file has one spelling
whichever project in the repository refers to it, and a file outside the
project directory needs no `..`.

ProjectNetClass.description:
One net class of the `.kicad_pro` (`net_settings.classes[]`). A value is
absent when the class does not state it: KiCad 9 and later then use the
`Default` class's value. Values are the file's millimetres converted to
nanometres (conventions.md §6).

kind.description: Root schematic, other schematic, or board.

formatVersion.description: The file's `(version N)`. Absent when the form is missing or not an integer.

generator.description: The file's `(generator …)`, quoted or bare, for example `eeschema` or `pcbnew`. Absent when the form is missing.

generatorVersion.description: The file's `(generator_version "…")`, for example `9.0` (KiCad 8 and later). Absent when the form is missing.

titleBlock.description: The file's own `(title_block …)` as written. Absent when the file has none.

expandedTitleBlock.description:
`titleBlock` with its text variables expanded by today's rule
(`backend/app/services/kicad_text_variables.py`; field map,
"Title-block expansion"): `${NAME}` takes, from lowest to highest
precedence, this title block's fields (`TITLE`, `ISSUE_DATE`,
`REVISION`, `COMPANY`, `COMMENT1`…`COMMENT9`, the empty string for an
absent one), this file's `properties`, the project's `textVariables`,
`PROJECTNAME` and `FILENAME` (this file's name); a reference to anything
else (`${CURRENT_DATE}`, `${#}`) stays as written. Present exactly when
`titleBlock` is. It has the same fields, except that a field or comment
whose expansion is empty is absent.

properties.description: The file's top-level `(property "<name>" "<value>")` forms, keyed by name; KiCad 8 and later write the project's text variables into a board this way. Keys in code point order; an empty name is skipped; when a name repeats, the last form wins. Empty for a schematic, which has no top-level properties.

ProjectDocument.description: One schematic file of the hierarchy, or the board.

kind.description: Which setting or form holds the reference.

documentPath.description: The repository-relative path of the file that holds the reference: the `.kicad_pro`, a schematic of the hierarchy, the board, a library table, or a drawing-sheet file.

sheetUuid.description: UUID of the `(sheet …)` that holds the reference. Present exactly when `kind` is `sheet-file`; it equals the `sheetSymbolUuid` of the semantic index's `sheetInstances[]` that the sheet places.

sheetName.description: The sheet's first `Sheetname` (or `Sheet name`) property as written. Present exactly when `kind` is `sheet-file` and that property has non-empty text.

libraryName.description: The library nickname, the row's `(name …)`. Present exactly when `kind` is `footprint-library` or `symbol-library`; unique within its table.

field.description:
Where in the file the text sits. Present exactly when `kind` is
`drawing-sheet` or `text-path`. In the `.kicad_pro`, the RFC 6901 JSON
Pointer of the value (`/schematic/page_layout_descr_file`). In an
s-expression file, the property name when the text is the value of a
`(property "<name>" …)` form, otherwise the head token of the list the
text is an element of (`descr`).

raw.description: The reference exactly as written, after s-expression or JSON string unescaping, `${KIPRJMOD}` and other variables unexpanded; never empty. Its resolved repository path, if any, is `target.path`.

variables.description: Names of the variables the expansion substituted, in any round, sorted in code point order, without repeats. Empty when the text holds none.

ProjectPathReference.description:
One path reference: the text as written, the variables its expansion
used, and where it leads. The resolution algorithm is normative in
`field-maps/project.md`, "Resolution"; in short: variables are expanded
(`PROJECTNAME` and the project's text variables first, then `KIPRJMOD`
and KiCad's library variables, up to 8 rounds), `\` becomes `/`, and the
result is classified by its form.

NonNegativeNanometres.description: A Nanometres value that is never negative: a thickness, width, diameter or length.

ProjectFileFormatVersion.description:
A KiCad s-expression file format version, the integer of the file's
`(version N)` form: a date written as YYYYMMDD, for example `20241229`
(KiCad 9) or `20260206` (KiCad 10).

date.description: `(date "…")`, KiCad's `${ISSUE_DATE}`, as written (not parsed as a date).

comments.description: The `(comment N "…")` forms with N from 1 to 9 and non-empty text, sorted by `number` in numeric order; when a number repeats, the last form in the file wins. Empty when there are none.

ProjectTitleBlock.description:
A `(title_block …)` form. Each field is present exactly when the form has
it with non-empty text; an empty string is treated as absent (KiCad writes
no empty title-block fields). This is the fork's `KiCadTitleBlock`, whose
empty strings stand for absent fields.

ProjectReferenceKind.description: Which KiCad file setting or form holds a path reference.

KiCadUuid.description:
KiCad object UUID in the canonical form KiCad writes (`KIID::AsString`):
lowercase hexadecimal, 8-4-4-4-12. Copied from the file, never generated
or re-cased.

ProjectVariableName.description:
Name of a path variable as written between `${` and `}` or `$(` and `)`:
ASCII letters, digits, `_` and `:`, as KiCad's expander reads them
(`common.cpp`, `KIwxExpandEnvVars`).

ProjectPathTarget.description: Where a path reference leads. The variant is chosen by `kind`.

ProjectTitleBlockComment.description: One numbered comment of a title block.

path.description:
The target's repository-relative path: the base directory's repository
path joined with the reference and normalized lexically (`.` dropped,
each `..` cancels the segment before it). Its bundle member is
`sources/<path>`.

base.description: The directory the path was joined to.

inSources.description:
True when the revision key's source set, as K materializes it, holds
the target: the file `path`, or, for a directory target such as a
`.pretty` footprint library, at least one file below it. Such a target
is read by the build and so is a member `sources/<path>` (the closure,
bundle-format.md §2.2). False means the file
is missing from the commit, or present but outside the revision key's
source set (for example under an excluded directory, or a file type the
source set does not select).

ProjectRepositoryTarget.description: The reference resolves to a path inside the repository.

path.description:
The target relative to the repository root, normalized lexically: one or
more leading `..` segments, then the rest. Not a RepoPath, since it
names no file of the repository.

base.description: The directory the path was joined to.

ProjectOutsideRepositoryTarget.description: The reference climbs above the repository root: KiCad would read a file the commit does not hold.

path.description: The expanded path with every `\` replaced by `/` and normalized lexically, as the source file states it; never a path of the build host.

ProjectAbsoluteTarget.description: The reference is an absolute path after expansion (`/…`, or a drive letter such as `C:/…`).

variable.description: The library variable as written, for example `KICAD9_3DMODEL_DIR` or `KISYS3DMOD`. A KiCad of another major version substitutes its own directory when this one is not set in its environment (`common.cpp`, `KIwxExpandEnvVars`); readers apply that rule, this document does not.

library.description: Which library directory the variable names.

relativePath.description: The rest of the path below that directory, normalized lexically, for example `Resistor_SMD.3dshapes/R_0603_1608Metric.step`.

ProjectKiCadLibraryTarget.description: The reference starts with one of KiCad's library variables, or names one as a `:<alias>:` form.

name.description: The embedded file's name, the text after `kicad-embed://`, equal to its `(name …)`.

documentPath.description: The repository-relative path of the document whose `(embedded_files …)` form holds it: the board, or the root schematic for the schematic drawing sheet.

footprintUuid.description: UUID of the footprint whose own `(embedded_files …)` holds it. Absent when the document-level form holds it. A model is looked up in its footprint's embedded files first, then in the board's.

ProjectEmbeddedTarget.description: The reference is `kicad-embed://<name>` and an embedded file of the lookup order holds that name.

variable.description:
The variable concerned. Present exactly when `reason` is
`undefined-variable` or `nondeterministic-variable` (the first such
reference, in text order, of the expansion round that stopped), or
`misplaced-variable` (the variable of the first marker, in text order,
that does not start the text).

ProjectUnresolvedTarget.description: The reference cannot be resolved from the sources alone.

ProjectTitleBlockCommentNumber.description: Number of a title-block comment, as in `(comment N "…")`: 1 to 9.

ProjectPathBase.description: Which directory a relative or `${KIPRJMOD}` path was joined to.

ProjectKiCadLibrary.description:
One of KiCad's own library directories, which the KiCad installation
defines through predefined path variables (`env_vars.cpp`). `<N>` is one
or more ASCII digits, any version.

ProjectLibraryRelativePath.description:
A path below one of KiCad's library directories: `/`-separated, relative,
no empty, `.` or `..` segment, no backslash and no `:`. The same
character rule as Common's RepoPath.

ProjectEmbeddedFileType.description: The `(type …)` of a `(file …)` in an `(embedded_files …)` form, spelled as KiCad writes it.

ProjectUnresolvedReason.description: Why a reference could not be resolved from the sources alone.
